results.question: Какова помесячная выручка от доставленных заказов с учётом скидок?
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) AS month,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_cents - o.discount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
        o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY 
        month
)
SELECT 
    month,
    SUM(revenue_cents) AS monthly_revenue_cents
FROM 
    delivered_orders
GROUP BY 
    month
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 100;
results.final_sql:

    WHERE

results.question: Какие категории имеют наибольшую стоимость проданных товаров в доставленных заказах до вычета скидок? Покажи все категории.
results.initial_sql:
SELECT 
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM(pi.quantity * (oi.unit_price_cents - o.discount_cents)) / 100 AS total_revenue_cents
FROM 
    categories c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN 
    orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    shipments s ON o.order_id = s.order_id
WHERE 
    s.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue_cents DESC
LIMIT 10;

results.question: Сколько заказов использовало каждый купон? Покажи также купоны без заказов.

    SELECT
        coupon_id,

    FROM

    WHERE
        coupon_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        coupon_id
)

FROM
    coupons c

    coupon_usage cu ON c.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
ORDER BY
    cu.order_count DESC, c.code;

results.question: Какие пять товаров купили в наибольшем количестве единиц в доставленных заказах?
results.initial_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN delivered_orders do ON oi.order_id = do.order_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.final_sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN delivered_orders do ON oi.order_id = do.order_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 5;
